target: December 22 2014 manuscript, page 30 Table 1 Panel B, 50-session row
primary: Q1 MA minus TSMOM monthly mean, reported 0.43 percentage points
levels: Cumulative total-return index, including dividends; price-vs-total-return ambiguity disclosed
signal: Close > current-inclusive 50-observation SMA or close > close 50 observations ago; equality earns cash
timing: One-session shift; gross close-to-close reproduction, not executable close fills
cash: Contemporaneous French daily RF as realized cash return, never a signal input
aggregation: Compound daily gross returns within calendar month; arithmetic mean across full months
deviations: August 2020 CRSP vintage from third-party snapshot, not original author inputs
Year endpoints interpreted as full calendar years; pre-1963 warmup
Total-return levels and equality-to-cash explicit assumptions
Original mean-difference inference insufficiently specified; bootstrap is supplemental, not original inference reproduction

numerical_check.reason: Prospective approximate-match screen allowing vintage/definition discrepancy, not formal equivalence
numerical_check.partial_rule: All ten means within tolerance and Q1 difference positive and within tolerance; otherwise numerical inconsistency under this implementation

uncertainty.method: Joint stationary calendar-month bootstrap of fixed-rule paired differences
uncertainty.correction: Holm across five quintile contrasts separately per block; all block choices reported
uncertainty.escalation: 20000 paths with same seed if any primary adjusted p falls in [0.04,0.06]
uncertainty.scope: Conditional on fixed strategy histories; does not undo prior research selection or establish independent investment evidence

costs: None in gross reproduction; economic implementation must be separately registered
